title: John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship (Curtin University)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (40% of tuition fee for the scholarship term)
duration: Credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree, or a maximum of 2 years for a Master's degree by coursework
description: Curtin University's John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship gives eligible international, fee-paying, non-sponsored students 40% off the tuition fee of their course, credited for up to four years of an undergraduate degree or two years of a Master's by coursework. Applicants need a Course-Weighted Average of 95% or equivalent in their most recent eligible study and must study at a Curtin Western Australian campus commencing in 2027 or 2028. No separate scholarship application is needed: all qualifying applications to Curtin are assessed automatically by Global Admissions.
